# ECN-2026-046 - Change notice - Machining induction billet heater #1

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P1, line P1-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P1-L3-IH01

Reason for change
The existing control setpoint for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) requires adjustment to meet downstream machining metallurgical targets. Analysis of as-run logs and metallurgical rejects identified a consistent offset. To bring delivered billets into the acceptable hardness and dimensional stability window, the target billet temperature for Machining induction billet heater #1 (EQ-P1-L3-IH01) is 1235 °C. This change aligns heater control with the corrective actions documented in ECN-2026-029 and refines operator procedures per SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05.

Affected items
- Control system setpoint configuration for EQ-P1-L3-IH01
- Operator operating procedure references in SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05
- Batch records and shift logs that reference the previous setpoint
- Training materials for operators assigned to line P1-L3

Implementation
- Update the setpoint in the PLC and DCS configuration for EQ-P1-L3-IH01 to the specified target temperature and lock change control per existing change management workflows referenced in ECN-2026-029.
- Revise step language in SOP-P1-L3-04 and SOP-P1-L3-05 to reflect the new target and to include verification and record steps consistent with plant documentation practice.
- Execute a controlled changeover during the next planned equipment window; perform verification runs and record actual measured billet inlet and outlet conditions to confirm the heater achieves the target.
- Deliver operator briefing and a one-time training update to all operators assigned to line P1-L3 covering the revised setpoint and verification steps. Update batch record templates to record setpoint confirmation.

Approvals
Prepared by: Maintenance Engineering, P1-L3  
Reviewed by: Process Engineering, P1-L3  
Approved by: Plant Operations Management

Related documents: ECN-2026-029, SOP-P1-L3-04, SOP-P1-L3-05
